Evidence: list() stats each entry with bare await fs.stat(entryPath); a dangling symlink/junction makes the whole batch reject
Reproduction: Create dir with a junction/symlink whose target is missing, then GET /api/workspace/files?path=/ or fs.list('/') — rejects ENOENT (probe: LIST_FAIL ENOENT ...\dangling)
Root cause: No per-entry error tolerance in the list batch; stat result is required for size/mtime
Impact: Repo panel tree and any list() consumer return 500/error for the entire directory because one entry is broken; broken symlinks are common in repos
Proposed fix: Wrap per-entry stat in try/catch and skip or synthesize a placeholder node (e.g. size 0, type from dirent)
Required tests: unit: list() with dangling symlink returns remaining entries; route test 200

Evidence: readBinary slices to first 1MB silently while read() appends a [TRUNCATED] marker (local-filesystem.ts:94)
Reproduction: fs.readBinary(path) on a >1MB file returns exactly 1048576 bytes with no signal of clipping
Root cause: Truncation feedback implemented only in the text path
Impact: Latent: no in-repo caller today (grep: no .readBinary outside domain), but a future binary consumer cannot distinguish full vs clipped content
Proposed fix: Return truncation metadata (e.g. { buffer, truncated, size }) or throw a typed error when clipped

Evidence: onEvent callbacks exist for file.updated/deleted/renamed but grep shows zero production call sites passing onEvent (only tests construct with it)

Impact: File-change notification is dead surface; nothing downstream observes writes/deletes/renames
Proposed fix: Either wire onEvent at the route/bootstrap construction sites into eventBroker, or document as reserved and stop advertising it as a feature
Required tests: integration: write via route → broker event observed

Evidence: rootRealCache TtlCache(60s, 200) — a root symlink flip inside the window resolves ops against the stale real root
Reproduction: Repoint a symlinked workspaceRoot to another directory, then call any op within 60s: containment is checked against the old realpath
Root cause: Deliberate cost tradeoff (comment at :104), documented in Domain Spec Gaps
Impact: Misjail for up to 60s after a root symlink change; scope is one process
Proposed fix: Reduce TTL, invalidate on mount/root change, or revalidate root realpath on cache hit for mutating ops
Required tests: unit: flip symlink → op within TTL is rejected/uses new root
